[THEORETICAL QUANTUM OPTICS]{.eyebrow}

<h1 class="profile-name">Nico S. Baßler</h1>

::: {.hero-summary}
Collective light–matter interactions.<br>
Quantum correlations. Open systems.
:::

I study how light and matter behave collectively, with a focus on superradiance, quantum emitter arrays, and the relation between collective dynamics and entanglement. My work combines analytical calculations with numerical simulations.

::: {.section-heading}
## Research interests

From microscopic interactions to collective behavior.
:::

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-item}
[01]{.item-number}

### Collective emission

Superradiance, subradiance, and the competition between collective dynamics and local decoherence.
:::
::: {.research-item}
[02]{.item-number}

### Quantum correlations

Entanglement, separability, and what collective observables tell us about a many-body quantum state.
:::
::: {.research-item}
[03]{.item-number}

### Light–matter interfaces

Cooperative optical response in emitter arrays, from optical elements to cavities and sensing.
:::
:::
